{{Quote|My nanny droid is broken. I want my mommy! I want to go home!|Finn to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Anakin to the Rescue">''[[Anakin to the Rescue]]''</ref>}}
'''Finn''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] [[Unidentified nanny droid (Coruscant)|his]] [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]] suffered a malfunction, leading Finn on a chase around the city. Eventually, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], who were traveling with [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] monarch [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] on the capital planet, helped Finn catch and repair the droid and returned him to his mother. [[Finn's mother]] helped Skywalker back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in thanks for his assistance in locating her son.
